ACCOUNT AND DATA DELETION
Delete your Collect account.
You may request deletion of your Collect account and associated eligible personal data.
Get the App
Email Collect support
Collect interface preview · Example data
Collect records contributions and does not hold customer funds. A deletion request does not move money, reverse a provider payment or confirm that records have been erased.
Delete in the app
Settings → Security → Delete data
Open Collect and sign in.
Go to Settings.
Select Security.
Select Delete data.
Choose a reason if you want to provide one.
Select Send verification code.
Enter the code sent to the phone number or confirmed email used for your Collect account and select Verify code.
If verification is unavailable, select Get help.
Select Submit request.
Review the confirmation and select Submit request.
Check or refresh request status in the app.
Delete without the app
Contact Collect support to request account deletion. You do not need to reinstall the app to submit a deletion request.
Email:
info@ikanisa.com
Email help and follow-up
If no email app opens, copy info@ikanisa.com into your email service.
Keep a copy of your email. If sending fails, check your email service before trying again.
For a follow-up, reply in the same conversation and include any request reference already supplied.
A sent email is not an acknowledgement from Collect or confirmation of deletion.
Request Account Deletion
Start by emailing info@ikanisa.com. Support can agree a suitable identity-verification step. Do not email a MoMo PIN, password, one-time code, authenticator secret or identity-document image.
Collect ID, if known
Registered telephone number, if needed to locate the account
Reason or details you choose to provide
What happens next
Verify your identity before submitting your request.
Submit your request for review.
Keep your request reference. In the app, check or refresh request status; by email, reply in the same support conversation.
Submitting a request does not delete your account or records. Your account remains accessible while review is pending. Check request status or contact support for the outcome and any records that need to be retained.
You may need to complete these steps first
Resolve pending contribution records, reversals or disputes
Arrange a group-owner or administrator handover where required
Keep a copy of records you need
Discuss an active security investigation or legal hold with support
Data we may retain
Contribution, reconciliation and audit records where a justified retention basis applies
Account and security records needed for an active investigation
Records needed to resolve a dispute or legal claim
Records subject to an identified applicable retention obligation or legal hold
A deletion request is not confirmation that ledger records, profiles or secured backups have been erased. Ask support which records are retained and why.
Products provided by partners
Collect does not currently offer lending, insurance or credit-readiness handoffs. A request to Collect does not cancel an independent contract you hold with another provider. Contact that provider directly about its own records or products.

How Collect protects customer information
Collect limits access to customer data by role and reason, protects data in transit, keeps operational audit trails, and minimises raw sensitive records where possible.
Personal data is not sold.
Customer funds are not held on Collect's own balance sheet.
Banks and insurers make their own regulated decisions.
Customer deletion and correction routes are available through app and support channels.
What Collect will not do
Collect does not make final loan, pricing, policy or claim decisions for regulated providers, and it does not expose private credit-readiness documents to group members.
No public training of private customer financial documents.
No sale of personal data.
No public promise of automatic credit, insurance or payout approval.
No unrestricted access to sensitive support records.
Partner and regulated-product boundary
Collect supports records, preparation, communication and customer-requested workflows. Licensed banks, insurers or approved providers remain responsible for their own KYC, AML/CFT, eligibility, pricing, approval, disbursement, claim and regulatory obligations.
Provider review remains separate from Collect public marketing copy.
Funds are handled through regulated financial-service partners where approved arrangements apply.
Partner handoff requires an appropriate legal basis and customer workflow.
Customer rights and deletion support
Customers can request access, correction, account deletion or data deletion. Some ledger, security, dispute, payment, tax, audit, legal or regulatory records may need limited retention.
Use the in-app account deletion request where available.
